name: olio.pb.locationVariant
label: Location Variant
description: PictureBook V3 §7 realization key for one olio.pb.location: 'night exterior', 'winter, from the road'. The five deltas (timeOfDay, weather, season, viewpoint, extra) are sparse strings layered over the location's description when a LOCATION node renders the variant or a scene plan carries it; the default variant is the one with no deltas. Lives beside its location in the world's Locations group. 'approvedRender' is the variant's own approved artifact (§7.1 item 1) - a variant does not inherit the location's. No field carries a schema default (TestPbModelSchema rule 3).

fields.name: extra
fields.description: Free-text delta the four named ones cannot carry ('after the fire', 'festival bunting').
